Wonderful Dinner & Outstanding Service at Saigon Kitchen Restaurant, Hôtel des Arts Saigon
Jun 2025 • Family
I had a lovely dinner at Saigon Kitchen Restaurant, Hôtel des Arts Saigon - MGallery Collection, and what made the experience even more memorable was the warm and attentive service from the staff—especially Ms. Mai Thùy, our F&B server for the evening.

From the moment we arrived, Ms. Mai Thùy made sure we were well taken care of. She was friendly, professional, and went out of her way to ensure we had everything we needed. Her recommendations were spot-on, and her thoughtful service truly enhanced our dining experience.

The ambiance of the restaurant was elegant and relaxing, and the food was both beautifully presented and delicious. Every detail—from the appetizers to dessert—was clearly crafted with care.

Thank you to the entire team, and especially to Ms. Mai Thùy, for making our evening so special. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy fine dining with exceptional service in Ho Chi Minh City!

Breakfast was great! I recommend calling a Grab on your way back.
Nov 2023 • Couples
The breakfast is very modern. The juice is gold pressed. You can choose a salad with grains, and the egg dishes are cooked to perfection. It's healthy, cozy, very delicious, and very satisfying. It's also perfect for lazing around in the morning.

But the taxi on the way back to the hotel was the worst. The hotel staff seemed to know me, but it was a rip-off. There was a familiar lettering like VANSAN written on the body, so I got in, but there was no meter. By the time I thought it was bad, the taxi was still running, so I just left it. The taxi on the way there was 20,000 VND, so I paid 25,000 VND, and suddenly the screen on my smartphone showed 36,000 VND.
It's not a big deal in terms of the amount, but it makes me feel bad, so I recommend that you visit the hotel with the intention of calling a Grab yourself on the way back.

Anyway, the breakfast is great❗️
